The Anker 100W Charging Base wirelessly recharges compatible Anker power banks with an instant boost of up to 100W (the Anker 737 Power Bank is not supported).
A total output of 100W is shared among 3 USB ports and 1 Pogo pin, so the base powers your essential devices at the same time.
GaN technology delivers reliable, high-powered charging from a base comparable in size to an original 96W single-port charger.
The intuitive LED indicator flashes during wireless recharging and stays steady once your power bank is fully charged.
Anker 100W Charging Base, a power cord, a welcome guide and a worry-free 12-month warranty.
